name: db-splice-from-previous
body: At netbeans scale the DB load is a multi-minute floor, so the DB must be seeded/spliced from the previous DB rather than rebuilt from scratch. A global projection pass over cached + re-emitted facts is allowed, but it must not require re-running the frontends for unchanged content. AC: a localized re-scan does not perform a full DB rebuild, and the resulting DB answers the same queries as a full rebuild.
